conditions.input: Identical SHA-256 verified 16 kHz mono PCM16 WAV; no trimming, gain changes or augmentation
conditions.pacing: Await adapter ready; send each 160 ms frame at its simulated capture end
conditions.first_caption: First nonempty partial OR final, relative to audio capture start
conditions.first_partial: First nonempty partial; null for Whisper, which emits finals only
conditions.caption_updates: Changed nonempty text per utterance; duplicate finals ignored; intervals within each clip include pauses
conditions.percentiles: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; undefined when no intervals exist
conditions.final_lag: Last unique nonempty final minus complete source WAV duration, including trailing silence; can be negative
conditions.ended: Ended acknowledgement relative to audio capture start
conditions.end_to_end: Capture start through stream close, including complete source duration
conditions.startup: Measured separately and excluded from capture-relative timings; Whisper ready means its capture buffer is ready
conditions.application_latency: Model/API benchmark, excluding browser, application WebSocket, translation and persistence startup
conditions.accuracy: Finalized text only; English Unicode word WER and Korean normalized character CER
conditions.missing_results: Successful empty recognition counts as deletions and is flagged; transport errors are unscored
conditions.warmup: Deployment verification is external; no timed samples are discarded or reused from tuning
conditions.sample_order: Manifest order, serial within this provider
